question: Menopause is defined as 12 consecutive months of amenorrhoea with no pathological cause, and the average age of menopause in Indian women is 45–47 years.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. Menopause requires exactly 12 consecutive months of amenorrhoea. The average age in India is 45–47 years — earlier than the Western average of ~51 years — which is clinically important when counselling Indian women.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. WHO defines menopause as 12 consecutive months of amenorrhoea due to loss of ovarian follicular activity. The average age in Indian women is 45–47 years, which is approximately 3–4 years earlier than the Western average of about 51 years.
